description: This Java class 'RetrieveSubjectsStrategy' implements a command strategy for handling 'RetrieveSubjects' commands within a policy management system. It retrieves subject information related to a specific policy entry, constructs responses, and manages entity tags for versioning.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectsStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing strategy pattern for handling 'RetrieveSubjects' policy queries, extending 'AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy' and providing logic to process commands, retrieve subjects, and manage version tags.

methods.name: RetrieveSubjectsStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the 'RetrieveSubjects' class.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command logic to retrieve subjects associated with a policy entry, returning a result with the response or error if not found.
parameters: Context<PolicyId> context - the context containing policy state
@Nullable Policy policy - the current policy, may be null
long nextRevision - the next revision number
RetrieveSubjects command - the command to execute

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag for the specified command and new policy entity, used for versioning.
parameters: RetrieveSubjects command - the command being processed
@Nullable Policy newEntity - the updated policy entity, may be null
